items.title: Nscale to acquire Anyscale, forming full-stack AI hyperscaler
items.what: Definitive agreement to buy Anyscale and its ~200 staff across US, Europe and India, expected to close H2 2026; value not disclosed.

items.title: Anyscale on Azure enters public preview
items.what: Platform can be provisioned inside a customer's own Azure tenancy with Entra SSO and MACC drawdown; Wayve and Xoople named as users.

items.title: AWS and Cerebras pair Trainium prefill with CS-3 decode
items.what: Inference disaggregation in AWS data centres using Trainium for prefill and Cerebras CS-3 for decode over EFA, exposed via Bedrock.

items.title: Amazon raises Spain investment to EUR 33.7 billion through 2035
items.what: Adds EUR 18B for data centres in Huesca, Zaragoza and Teruel plus a dedicated AI and ML server manufacturing and repair facility, ~1,800 jobs.

items.title: AWS European Sovereign Cloud goes live in Brandenburg
items.what: First sovereign region GA with 90+ services on a EUR 7.8B German investment; sovereign Local Zones planned for Belgium, Netherlands, Portugal.

items.title: Agent-Native Cloud and 560,000 Zhenwu chips shipped
items.what: Launched AgentLoop and AgentTeams, previewed 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen 3.8-Max, and disclosed 560,000 cumulative in-house Zhenwu AI chip shipments across 400+ customers.

items.title: Alibaba Cloud opens Paris and Johor regions
items.what: New zones in France, Malaysia, Japan and Mexico take the footprint to 105 availability zones across 32 regions.

items.title: H1 2026: datacenter spend pulled forward from 2027
items.what: Net revenue EUR 1,302.9M (+19%); capex guided to ~7% of net revenue for FY2026, pulling 2027 investment into H2 2026 to secure compute and storage and lock in pricing.

items.title: Adyen to acquire billing platform Orb for USD 335 million
items.what: All-cash purchase of the San Francisco enterprise billing platform, expected to close 1 July 2026.

items.title: Apple opens 20,000 sq ft Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston
items.what: Sits inside the Houston plant that already builds Apple's advanced AI servers for Private Cloud Compute, funded with hundreds of millions in under nine months.

items.title: Apple commits over USD 30 billion to Broadcom for US chips
items.what: Multiyear agreement covering more than 15 billion US-made chips, with USD 1.5B expanding Broadcom's Fort Collins facility.

items.title: Apple doubles Houston campus, adds US Mac mini production
items.what: Doubles the campus footprint and expands the advanced AI server line Apple says is ahead of schedule.

items.title: Autodesk and University of Florida open robotics construction lab
items.what: USD 1M donation opens the Autodesk Design and Make Laboratory with collaborative robots, digital twins in Fusion and computer vision.

items.title: Autodesk completes MaintainX acquisition
items.what: Closed the purchase of the mobile-first CMMS vendor; price not disclosed.

items.title: First fully autonomous excavator deployments on live sites
items.what: Excavators retrofitted with the Bedrock Operator sensor-and-compute suite now work with no operator for Sundt, Zachry Construction and three others.

items.title: Plant Munich: EUR 650 million transformation, i3 output from August
items.what: Converts Plant Munich to all-electric with AI camera quality control, Automated Surface Inspection and digital twins; fully electric by 2027.

items.title: Humanoid robots to enter German production at Plant Leipzig
items.what: Pilots Hexagon Robotics AEON at Leipzig from summer 2026 and sets up a Center of Competence for Physical AI in Production.

items.title: Q2 2026: active power to 1.5 GW, backlog about USD 104 billion
items.what: Revenue USD 2,575M from USD 1,212M a year earlier, active power up nearly 500 MW to 1.5 GW, contracted power ~3.7 GW, and USD 14.1B spent on property and equipment in six months.

items.title: CoreWeave enters Indonesia with 360 MW across three sites
items.what: Three facilities totalling 360 MW of contracted IT power due online in 2028, with CoreWeave owning and operating the compute at all three.

items.title: NVIDIA invests USD 2 billion to back 5 GW of CoreWeave AI factories
items.what: NVIDIA bought USD 2B of Class A stock at USD 87.20 to accelerate more than 5 GW of AI factories by 2030 spanning Rubin, Vera CPUs and BlueField storage.

items.title: Social Commerce and cloud-streamed Instant Play Quests
items.what: Instant Play Quests stream trials with no install via NVIDIA GeForce NOW and Amazon GameLift Streams, piloted with NetEase Marvel Rivals.

items.title: Encord raises USD 60 million Series C led by Wellington
items.what: Earmarked for scaling the data platform; data under management grew from 1 PB to over 5 PB in twelve months and physical-AI revenue rose 10x.

items.title: Point cloud labeling gains 1-Click Cuboid and Smart Interpolation
items.what: Adds 1-Click Segmentation and Cuboid plus Smart Interpolation for tracking cuboids across time in 3D point cloud data.

items.title: Foxglove launches Agentic Data Platform for Physical AI
items.what: Bundles natural-language querying, Semantic Search, Remote Access live streaming from deployed robots and Bring Your Own Storage.

items.title: Bring Your Own Storage generally available on all major clouds
items.what: BYOS spans AWS, Google Cloud and Azure across 14 regions as a paid add-on.

items.title: Q2 2026: Virgo Network links a million AI accelerators
items.what: Cloud revenue grew 82% with backlog at USD 514B; the Virgo Network connects a million AI accelerators across multiple data centre sites into one supercomputer.

items.title: Cloud Next 26 unveils TPU 8t and TPU 8i
items.what: TPU 8t scales to 9,600 chips and 2 PB of shared HBM per superpod at 3x Ironwood compute; TPU 8i links 1,152 chips per pod.

items.title: Google adds USD 1.5 billion to Jackson County, Alabama campus
items.what: Expansion covering 2026 and 2027 with a USD 2M Energy Impact Fund alongside TVA.

items.title: Record Q2 2026 and USD 750 million buyback
items.what: Revenue USD 997M (+22%), profit USD 235M, FY guidance raised to USD 4.10-4.15B; only cloud cost increases of USD 12M cited on infrastructure.

items.title: On-demand autonomous vehicle pilot launching in Punggol
items.what: Moves from fixed shuttle loops to on-demand AV booking with ~90,000 km logged, a Punggol AV depot and commercial fares from Q4 2026.

items.title: Euisun Chung sets Physical AI vision at San Francisco AI Summit
items.what: Confirmed a 50,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU supply agreement and Robot Reference Platform, Waymo collaboration on IONIQ 5 at Metaplant America, and a US robot plant scaling to 30,000 units a year by 2028.

items.title: KRW 9 trillion Saemangeum hub with a 50,000-GPU AI data center
items.what: MOU for a Gunsan complex: KRW 5.8T AI data centre scaled to 50,000 GPUs, KRW 1.3T solar, KRW 1T electrolyzer, robotics at 30,000 units a year; ground break 2027, completion 2029.

items.title: Introducing Mercury 2, a reasoning diffusion LLM
items.what: 128K context window, tunable reasoning and native tool use, running at about 1,009 tokens per second on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.

items.title: Mercury 2 lands on Azure AI Foundry
items.what: Became available through Microsoft's Azure AI Foundry model catalogue.

items.title: Inferact Platform fully certified for Kimi K3 vendor verification
items.what: Production inference stack built on open-source vLLM passed full Kimi K3 Vendor Verification; no hardware vendors or GPU models disclosed.

items.title: Xeon 6+ on 18A, E835 Ethernet and Crescent Island GPU
items.what: Launched Xeon 6+ with up to 288 E-cores on Intel 18A and detailed Crescent Island at 480GB LPDDR5X in a 350W air-cooled PCIe card; ASUS, Dell, Ericsson, GIGABYTE, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are already building systems.

items.title: Intel 18A-P enters risk production
items.what: First performance enhancement of the 18A family gives 9% more performance at iso-power or 18% lower power at iso-performance.

items.title: Security and Resiliency Initiative expands across Europe
items.what: Extends the USD 1.5 trillion, 10-year initiative from the UK into Continental Europe across five verticals including frontier and strategic technologies.

items.title: Lambda prices USD 926 million senior secured term loan B
items.what: Priced at SOFR+300 maturing 31 December 2030, with proceeds stated for acquiring and installing GPU servers and related infrastructure for an investment-grade offtaker.

items.title: MLPerf Training v6.0: fastest LLM training times
items.what: Submitted 18 nodes x 4 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 plus HGX B200 systems, training Llama 3.1 8B in 11.59 minutes on GB300.

items.title: Stable-Worldmodel platform for reproducible world model research
items.what: Released a Lance-backed platform for reproducible world model research and benchmarking under visual and physical distribution shifts.

items.title: Ford names the Fathom, carrying Latitude hands-free driving
items.what: Ford revealed the Fathom midsize electric truck at USD 28,350 starting MSRP with Louisville Assembly production in 2027, carrying the hands-free system Latitude develops in-house.

items.title: Lila wins three Phase I awards in DOE Genesis Mission
items.what: Selected for three Genesis Mission Lighthouse Challenges with Caltech, Lawrence Berkeley, Northwestern and Argonne.

items.title: Lila builds agent-driven science on NVIDIA BioNeMo Agent Toolkit
items.what: Adopted the toolkit for autonomous agents that test their own hypotheses in a physical lab.

items.title: Luma runs production inference on AMD MI325X via Tensorwave
items.what: Thousands of AMD Instinct MI325X GPUs on Tensorwave serve production generation, migrated with minimal porting and no quality regression.

items.title: Luma opens Riyadh MENA headquarters tied to HUMAIN Project Halo
items.what: Regional HQ to build the first Saudi-built Arabic-native foundation model, supported by Project Halo, a 2 GW AI supercluster.
